keys.anywhere.name: anywhere
keys.anywhere.01: this screen · the ? button · /keys · /tour shows the first-run tour again
keys.anywhere.03: every look and behaviour setting back to its default; asks y first, keeps your login, tabs, lists and rules
keys.anywhere.05: log in · account menu (link, log out)
keys.anywhere.08: who you're logged in as · log out
keys.anywhere.09: who you follow is live, as a list (also /following, /live)
keys.anywhere.10: your twitch follows, live first: space picks, enter adds them as tabs
keys.anywhere.11: your emotes: rename, reorder, remove, undo, sets, share (/emotes)
keys.chat.name: chat
keys.chat.01: pick a line; a reply's ↳ line opens its thread; a went-live line opens that channel (its tab, else a temporary one)
keys.chat.02: line menu: reply, copy, note, mute, block, mod, pin
keys.chat.03: filter this tab: a word or @name (/pattern/ works too), enter keeps, esc clears
keys.chat.07: jump to the last-read line, clear it
keys.chat.09: filter this tab (the bar at the top)
keys.chat.11: hide the pinned line (your channel or a twitch mod: unpin for everyone)
keys.chat.12: this twitch channel's prediction (also /predictions, or click its banner)
keys.chat.13: tab mode: move, reorder, close tabs from the keys
keys.chat.14: watch this channel's stream (mpv, else the browser)
keys.chat.15: streamer mode: show or hide the whispers tab for this session (a click on a hidden line shows it too)
keys.picked_line.name: a picked line
keys.picked_line.02: reply to it (whispers: answer that person)
keys.picked_line.03: its reply thread, oldest first (again, esc or h goes back; the menu copies it)
keys.picked_line.04: line menu: copy, note, mute, block, hide; a post: upvote, bookmark, edit, delete; op to feed; whispers: delete dm
keys.picked_line.06: open its first link (a video plays)
keys.picked_line.08: open it (mentions, feed; a folded run of timeouts); in whispers: answer that person, or retry a failed send
keys.picked_line.10: delete your own dm (whispers; it asks first, and the other person loses it too; also in the m menu)
keys.picked_line.11: back out of a thread, like the ← back tab
keys.chat_logs.name: chat logs (line menu or card → chat logs)
keys.chat_logs.02: oldest, newest (the ▼ chip jumps down too); the top loads older lines
keys.chat_logs.03: search their lines (enter finds, esc clears)
keys.chat_logs.04: swap this channel and every channel
keys.chat_logs.05: copy the picked line's public link
keys.typing.name: typing
keys.typing.02: complete emote, name, command; again to cycle
keys.typing.04: turns into the emoji when sent
keys.typing.05: older, newer sent lines (with the list open: move in it)
keys.typing.08: merged tab sends to: all feeds, then each alone
keys.typing.09: merged tab: send to twitch, kick, youtube on or off
keys.typing.13: erase the letter before, after the cursor
keys.typing.15: close the list, end a tab cycle, clear the search, drop the reply, let a picked line go (vi: leave typing)
keys.editing.name: editing the box
keys.editing.05: delete, change, copy, then a move: dw, c$
keys.picker.name: picker
keys.picker.04: next, previous tab: emotes, gifs, emoji (gifs: type to search, enter inserts the link; emoji: fuzzy search, enter inserts it)
keys.picker.05: search 7tv, ffz, heatsync, exact names only (the chips; kept on this machine)
keys.picker.06: upload your own emote: pick a picture, name it (one word), it lands in your set. needs a login
keys.picker.09: erase a letter in the search, clear it
keys.emotes.name: your emotes (ctrl-p)
keys.emotes.03: rename · removed: restore · sets: apply (y yes, n no)
keys.emotes.04: move it to a slot you type (a taken slot trades places)
keys.emotes.05: carry it down, up one place
keys.emotes.07: yes to a question it asks (n or esc: no)
keys.emotes.09: share your set (copies the link), stop sharing
keys.emotes.10: import a channel's 7tv, bttv and ffz emotes
keys.tabs.name: tabs
keys.tabs.01: jump to a tab (alt-0 is the tenth)
keys.tabs.04: row mode (no vi needed): pick a line with j k (g, home: first line; shift-g, end: last), then the picked-line keys; esc lets go
keys.tabs.05: open a tab; the ⚙ is settings, the ? is this screen
keys.tabs.06: clear a red, cyan or yellow tab; else its menu: edit, remove (a temporary tab: keep; built-ins: hide), clear lines, bell (go-live popups for the channel: default, on, off), mute pings (its mentions still reach the mentions tab, silently), show twitch / kick / youtube on a merged tab (off hides that platform's lines there: not drawn, no pings; kept on this device only), share layout, use a shared layout, and announce, poll, prediction for a twitch room you run
keys.tabs.07: tab to the buttons: watch, status, predictions, summary; j l next, k h back, enter runs
keys.mod.name: mod
keys.mod.04: hover buttons on a line: /modbuttons x 10m ban, off clears
keys.mod.05: an automod hold: click, or its line menu
keys.mod.06: blocked terms: j k move, x delete, a add, / filter
keys.mod.07: warn with a reason, shout out, shield mode
keys.mod.08: shield, automod (h l), unban requests (y approve, x deny), chatters
keys.mod.09: stream and chat modes: enter flips a mode, h l its wait
keys.tab_mode.name: tab mode (space t)
keys.picture.name: picture
keys.picture.01: a picture in chat fills the pane
keys.picture.02: a video plays (mpv, else the browser)
keys.picture.04: move around it · or the wheel
keys.picture.06: close it · or click, or the ← back tab
keys.settings.name: settings (ctrl-,)
keys.settings.04: filter the list: type, enter stops typing, esc clears
keys.settings.05: flip it, open a list, or ask to reset everything to defaults
keys.settings.06: step a choice down, up (zoom, tab side, counter, pickers)
keys.settings.07: after the reset question: yes (any other key keeps your settings)
keys.followed.name: followed (ctrl-b)
keys.followed.02: open their tab, else an underlined temporary one (one slot; /keep or chatting in it saves it)
keys.followed.03: watch the stream (mpv, else the browser)
keys.import.name: import (/import)
keys.import.04: add the picked ones as tabs
keys.mod_tools.name: mod tools (/modtools)
keys.mod_tools.02: flip shield, run a row, ask about a request
keys.mod_tools.04: on an unban request: approve, deny (then y or enter sure, n or esc cancel)
keys.menus.name: menus and cards
keys.menus.04: a ban's reasons: the number picks it
keys.menus.05: yes, when it asks to unpin for everyone
keys.menus.07: in a card of a live twitch channel: clip it, copies the link (again: opens the edit page)
keys.lists.name: your lists (settings → muted & blocked people, filter rules…)
keys.lists.02: a person: their card · a mention rule or a mod toolbar button: on or off · the add row: type a new entry
keys.lists.03: remove the picked one (unmute, unblock, unhide, delete)
keys.lists.04: add an entry: a rule, ban reason or mention rule
keys.lists.05: a filter rule: edit it in place (live match count), notify on or off, pick its sound, volume down or up
keys.lists.06: filter rules and mention rules: the other kinds of rule and the syntax
keys.marks.name: little marks on a line (what they mean)
keys.marks.01: a chatter introducing themselves for the first time
keys.marks.02: a white bar: a chatter back after a long time away
keys.marks.03: a magenta bar and ◇: their very first message in this channel
keys.marks.04: said in a partner channel's room, in a twitch shared chat (just shared if the room isn't known)
keys.marks.05: a twitch power-up: the message plays an effect, like fx:simmer
keys.marks.06: in the message box near the length limit: yellow close to it, red past it
keys.cmd.op: post a thread to your heatsync feed
keys.cmd.re: answer the last op shown in chat
keys.cmd.dm: heatsync dm (needs a follow both ways)
keys.cmd.r: answer the last whisper or dm
keys.cmd.keep: save this temporary tab (a channel opened from following)
keys.cmd.sharelayout: copy your tabs as a heatsync.org/m/ link (/sl)
keys.cmd.layout: open the tabs of a heatsync.org/m/ link
keys.cmd.watch: watch this channel's stream (mpv, else the browser)
keys.cmd.delete: delete a line (or select it, press m)
keys.cmd.nuke: delete recent lines containing a term (mods)
keys.cmd.warn: a twitch warning they must accept to chat
keys.cmd.color: your twitch chat color; hex needs turbo or prime
keys.cmd.modtools: shield mode, automod levels, unban requests, chatters (mods)
keys.cmd.summary: this tab's stream stats: lines, chatters, top emotes
keys.cmd.status: this twitch channel's stream and chat modes (mods change them)
keys.cmd.predictions: this twitch channel's prediction: odds, points, bettors, the clock (read only)
keys.cmd.mute: hide someone, a day by default
keys.cmd.hide: hide someone here, or a tab
keys.cmd.note: a private note on someone; no text deletes it
keys.cmd.reset: put every look and behaviour setting back to its default (asks first)
keys.cmd.banreason: a quick reason your bans offer; alone, list them
keys.cmd.modbuttons: the hover buttons on a line you can moderate
keys.cmd.rule: hide / highlight rules: words, patterns, users, badges
keys.cmd.login: log in; when in, link a platform
keys.cmd.account: who you are logged in as, and how to log out
keys.cmd.following: who you follow that is live: game, viewers, uptime; enter opens a tab, w watches
keys.cmd.import: add the channels you follow on twitch as tabs: pick, enter adds
keys.cmd.emotes: your heatsync emotes: rename, reorder, remove, undo, saved sets, share (ctrl-p)
keys.cmd.tour: the first-run tour again: six short cards
keys.cmd.tab: go to a tab: a channel, feed, mentions, whispers, modlog
keys.cmd.follow: follow them on heatsync: their posts fill your feed
keys.cmd.clearsent: forget the messages up and down recall, here and on disk
keys.cmd.lclear: empty this tab's lines (only here, not for anyone else)
keys.reply.nudge: replying · want a reply button on hover? /hoverreply turns it on
keys.reply.cannot: that line can't be replied to
